attributes.precedence: data-kappa-theme takes precedence over data-mode on the same element, and nested scopes override their ancestors.

groups.label: Surfaces
groups.description: Page, panel, and control backgrounds, plus their recessed and overlay steps.

groups.label: Text
groups.description: Body copy, emphasis, supporting text, and placeholders.

groups.label: Accent
groups.description: The dicehub accent for links, selected indicators, and solid actions.

groups.label: Selection
groups.description: Selected states that pair a fill with readable contrast text.

groups.label: Status
groups.description: Informational, success, warning, and danger colors as text, solid fill, and tint.

groups.label: Charts
groups.description: Ordered series colors for data visualization in light and dark themes.

groups.label: Borders and focus
groups.description: Hairline separators, stronger boundaries, and keyboard focus rings.

groups.label: Supporting
groups.description: Shadows, backdrops, and the compatibility values existing components require.

tokens.name: --kappa-canvas
tokens.description: Application page background behind every surface.

tokens.name: --kappa-base
tokens.description: Base panel surface for cards, popovers, and raised regions.
tokens.compatibility: Previously undefined, so components fell back to #ffffff in both modes.

tokens.name: --kappa-control
tokens.description: Interactive control surface for inputs, buttons, and menus.

tokens.name: --kappa-control-hover
tokens.description: Hover surface for neutral action controls.

tokens.name: --kappa-tint
tokens.description: Recessed surface for grouped rows, tracks, and low-emphasis fills.

tokens.name: --kappa-overlay
tokens.description: Hover and overlay fill for rows, options, and quiet controls.

tokens.name: --kappa-disabled-surface
tokens.description: Fill for disabled inputs and disabled previews.
tokens.compatibility: Aliases --kappa-tint. Disabled text is exempt from contrast minimums.

tokens.name: --kappa-readonly-surface
tokens.description: Fill for read-only fields that stay focusable.
tokens.compatibility: Aliases --kappa-tint.

tokens.name: --kappa-dicehub-logo-foreground
tokens.description: Default dicehub logo and wordmark ink. Explicit black and white variants stay fixed.

tokens.name: --kappa-default
tokens.description: Default body and control text.

tokens.name: --kappa-strong
tokens.description: Highest-emphasis headings, values, and selected labels.
tokens.compatibility: Previously provided by the documentation shell as --docs-strong.

tokens.name: --kappa-subtle
tokens.description: Supporting text, labels, and icons.
tokens.compatibility: Light value corrected from #737373 (4.27:1 on tint) to #696969 (4.95:1 on tint).

tokens.name: --kappa-muted
tokens.description: Placeholders and inactive copy.
tokens.compatibility: Aliases --kappa-subtle so placeholders move with supporting text.

tokens.name: --kappa-accent

tokens.name: --kappa-selected-contrast

tokens.name: --kappa-selected-text

tokens.name: --kappa-line-strong
tokens.description: Decorative boundary that is stronger than the hairline: grips, keycaps, and scrollbar thumbs.

deprecations.name: --kappa-selected
deprecations.note: Withdrawn as a global default because a single value served both selection fills and selection text. Component fallback chains still read an explicit --kappa-selected override first; set --kappa-selected-contrast beside it so the pair stays readable.
